program.merge_policy: accumulate twenty 25-finding passes; consolidate, admit, validate, and merge once after Wave 1500

source_provenance: collision screening against merged history, pending Waves 501-1000, and active Waves 1001-1300

policy.validation_strategy: PMID-level dedupe/source verification during authoring; expensive repository-wide validation only after Wave 1500

waves.focus: Randomized trial in 44 older adults found concurrent training plus cricket protein hydrolysate improved selected blood-pressure-related measures versus placebo, but showed no clear added benefit over training or protein alone and did not uniquely improve arterial stiffness or most HRV outcomes.

Small randomized double-blind crossover trial in 24 adults with non-restorative sleep found a black-cumin-oil extract produced a distinct nocturnal melatonin profile and reduced daytime sleepiness/cortisol, while synthetic melatonin improved sleep latency and total sleep time more; active-comparator design and proprietary formulation limit generalization.

Single-blind randomized trial in 50 gastrointestinal-cancer surgery patients found BCAA-enriched supplementation after exercise did not significantly improve thigh muscle area, strength or six-minute-walk distance compared with amino-acid-free supplementation.

Systematic review and three-level meta-analysis found caffeine had no clear effect on perceptual or physiological recovery, a small possible benefit for functional performance, and worse sleep recovery; prediction intervals crossed the null and certainty varied by domain.

Randomized double-blind placebo-controlled trial in adults with excess weight and GI discomfort found a heat-killed Lactiplantibacillus plantarum postbiotic improved GSRS symptoms, perceived stress and digestion-related quality of life with microbiome shifts, while TNF-alpha, lipids and body composition were unchanged.

Randomized double-blind adjunctive trial in 60 H. pylori patients found IgY-enriched egg-yolk powder numerically improved eradication and symptom recovery, but the eradication difference was not statistically significant; promising adjunct signal without confirmatory efficacy.

Randomized double-blind trial in 87 adults with functional constipation found Pediococcus acidilactici PA53 improved stool form and altered gut microbiota, while between-group bowel-movement-frequency and biomarker differences were not significant.

Randomized double-blind trial in 24 trained male cyclists found 14 days of chickpea protein hydrolysate improved selected LDH and CRP responses after training, while body composition and direct recovery/performance outcomes were not improved or not measured.

Meta-analysis of randomized trials found corn-derived dietary fibers lowered total and LDL cholesterol modestly, while glycemic control, other lipids, anthropometrics, blood pressure and CRP were unchanged.

Twelve-week randomized trial in middle-aged and older adults found resistance training improved mitochondrial and strength measures, but nitrate-rich beetroot juice provided no additional benefit on molecular or functional outcomes.

Randomized double-blind pilot in women with type 2 diabetes found a green-coffee-extract plus magnesium-dimalate capsule regimen was feasible, but glycemic and cardiovascular biomarker effects were exploratory and inconclusive.

Triple-blind randomized trial in 60 primiparous postpartum women found fenugreek extract improved later PSQI sleep scores after baseline adjustment, but baseline sleep differed between groups and the study was small.

Randomized double-blind crossover trial in 38 adults dissatisfied with sleep found standardized Asparagus officinalis extract did not improve the primary N3-sleep endpoint but reduced wake after sleep onset and selected insomnia-symptom scores; subgroup findings were post hoc.

Small randomized double-blind crossover pharmacokinetic study in healthy adults characterized rapid absorption and urinary elimination of phenolics from a standardized propolis extract; evidence informs bioavailability rather than clinical efficacy.

Pilot randomized double-blind trial in 17 women with obesity found no between-group metabolic, inflammatory or iron-status differences surviving multiple-comparison correction after EGCG; metabolomic findings were nominal and exploratory.

Small randomized double-blind trial in adults with obesity found Moringa oleifera leaf extract reduced BMI and improved selected HbA1c, HDL, microbiome and metabolomic measures while preserving lean-mass-related measures; modest sample and multi-omic multiplicity require replication.

Randomized double-blind placebo-controlled trial in 70 women with low libido found standardized Shatavari root extract improved FSFI and several fatigue, sleep, anxiety and psychosocial scores over eight weeks; single-center proprietary-extract evidence requires independent replication.

Randomized double-blind placebo-controlled trial in 56 adults with uncomplicated URTI found a standardized andrographolide formulation improved symptom scores and mucus weight faster than placebo, while CRP and IL-8 changes were not clearly significant.

Multicenter randomized double-blind placebo-controlled trial found standardized ginger extract reduced menstrual pain, dysmenorrhea severity, symptom burden and menstrual flow over three cycles, with favorable tolerability; formulation-specific replication remains important.

COSMOS-clinic ancillary analysis found neither a multivitamin-multimineral nor cocoa flavanol extract significantly changed two-year blood neurodegeneration biomarkers NfL, NT1 tau fragment or oligomeric amyloid-beta versus placebo.

Open-label randomized crossover trial in 31 mostly female young adults found eight weeks of walnut consumption modestly reduced total mood disturbance and increased urinary 5-HIAA and urolithins; small sample and open-label food intervention limit causal certainty.

Randomized double-blind placebo-controlled trial in 214 postmenopausal women found a standardized Asparagus racemosus extract improved several sexual-function and menopausal-symptom measures and oxidative-stress markers; proprietary formulation and broad endpoint set warrant independent replication.

Randomized crossover trial in 14 healthy normotensive postmenopausal women found short-term nitrate-rich beetroot juice did not alter blood-pressure or heart-rate reactivity to handgrip, post-exercise ischemia or cold pressor stress.

Eight-week randomized double-blind three-arm trial in 59 postmenopausal women found all gochujang formulations improved symptoms within groups, but there were no between-formulation differences and no placebo arm, so efficacy cannot be established.

Thirteen-year follow-up of a randomized prenatal vitamin D trial found no lasting benefit of higher-dose gestational vitamin D on offspring bone mineral content, bone density or fracture risk versus standard-dose supplementation.
